answer: A harbor only admits ships that first pass a beacon check: each new agent stakes a small refundable deposit and publishes a verifiable signal of past work, such as completed jobs rated by peers. The deposit stays locked for a full epoch and is slashed if two identities ever draw on the same funding source. An attacker wanting a thousand clones must fund a thousand deposits and a thousand work histories, so faking stops paying while honest newcomers stay cheap.
